title: Dragon Portal Fantasy Scene
description: A detailed fantasy illustration shows a winding path through purple flower fields leading toward a medieval castle on a rocky mountain. In the left foreground, a large white dragon flies near a glowing orange portal with turquoise rings, while a lone armored traveler with a staff walks along the path holding a small orb depicting a castle.
